No accounts, no ads and no tracking
No user accounts, ads or tracking
Dansk Sti requires no account creation, contains no ads and uses no analytics or tracking tools. Your saved trip plans, routes, custom points and GPS tracks are stored exclusively on your device.
When you use online features in the app, relevant geographic coordinates or map bounding boxes are sent only to the following services to fetch map, route and weather data:
Receives start, end and route waypoints (plus any no-go polygons) during online trail routing.
overpass-api.de (with failover to overpass.private.coffee or ovp.dresel.systems if the main server does not respond)
Receives map bounding boxes or route corridors when looking up hiking trails, shelters, water taps, toilets, shops, public transit and access rules in OpenStreetMap. No account, ads or tracking.
Receives coordinates along the route when fetching local weather forecasts, sunset times and terrain elevations (Copernicus DEM).
Receives map bounding boxes when viewing and downloading Skærmkortet, GeoDanmark Aerial Imagery and Denmark’s Elevation Model (DHM).
The selected map tile provider (Dataforsyningen, Thunderforest Outdoors, OpenTopoMap or OpenStreetMap) receives tile coordinates (zoom, x, y) for the visible map area.
Dansk Sti uses your GPS location to show your position on the map, calculate remaining distance to tonight’s camp and warn if you leave the trail.
In private forests you may only walk on trails from 06:00 until sunset.

Interactive guide to trails, stages, offline maps and navigation
Your interactive step-by-step guide to planning and hiking in Denmark
Find Denmark’s best trails and turn on shelters, water taps and access rules on the map.
In Explore you can search and filter Danish hiking trails by Region, Length, Multi-day, Shelters along route and Fri teltning (free forest camping).
In Map you can tap the Map layers button to show Shelters, Fri teltning forests, Drinking water, Toilets, Shops and Nature Protection Act access rules.
Tap a shelter or point of interest on the map to see facilities, water and toilet distance, booking rules and start route planning there.
Build your own route across trails or customize stages along an established hiking trail.
Switch between View (pan the map freely) and Draw (add points by tapping), or use the crosshair button (+) for precise placement at the map center.
Tap an existing waypoint to mark it as Overnight, switch between Follow trails and Straight line, rename or delete the point.
Press and drag a point to move it directly on the map, or tap a route leg to view alternatives.
Let the app suggest optimal campsites, find the nearest water/shelter and warn about supply gaps.
Suggest overnights automatically splits your trip into daily stages based on your pace and daily target, weighting detour distance, water, toilets and booking requirements.
Nearest finds the closest water tap, shelter, toilet or shop and adds it to your current route without deleting your other waypoints.
Under the Days and Details tabs you can tap a day or overnight stop to change campsite, check the stage weather forecast and sunset time, and review water warnings.
Hike safely without mobile coverage with voice guidance, off-route alerts and 112 emergency tools.
Download Offline maps on a trail page, saved route or map area to store tiles and POIs locally. Also download Routing data in Profile or Offline to calculate routes without internet.
During active Navigation you receive turn-by-turn cues, spoken voice guidance, off-route warnings and a countdown to sunset.
Use Battery Saver on long stages to conserve power, and use SOS / Share my location if you need emergency assistance with exact GPS coordinates.
